site: Cross-portal diagnostic capture and local dashboard
class: Raw observation copied to durable diagnostics without a privacy boundary
symptom: Failure/review screenshots, HTML, page recordings, console logs and events could retain applicant values and secrets; the evidence route served employer HTML as executable dashboard-origin content.
root_cause: Capture paths wrote raw observations independently. Password-only text masking and resolved-root containment did not sanitize the contents or make HTML non-executable.
why_tests_missed: Tests asserted artifact existence and raw format, without synthetic PII/auth/document sentinels, masking restoration, direct route content-type checks or retention safety.
fix: Centralized structural projections, conservative visual covering, bounded safe writers, content-bound manifests, event/log projections, plain-text evidence serving and diagnostic-only retention; no raw fallback.
prevention: Make diagnostic capture a storage-only, fail-closed boundary from the outset. Test content privacy and restoration separately from runtime perception, authority, replay and path containment.
